summary: Team Chat Phase 4 (UGC moderation, Apple Guideline 1.2) tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest scenarios pass against the public URL — (a) guidelines gate 403 -> accept -> 200, (b) profanity filter 400, (c) 3 distinct reports auto-hide the message for everyone, (d) block/unblock filter + /blocks listing works, (e) sender can delete own (200) / non-admin delete other (403), (f) /team/chat/flags is admin-only (403 non-admin, 200 reviewsadmin). Frontend: applereview reset (chat_guidelines_accepted_at unset) then verified via Playwright — tapping chat-send opens chat-guidelines-modal, tapping chat-accept-guidelines dismisses it, the queued message posts as a bubble, and long-press on own bubble opens chat-actions-modal with chat-action-delete. Second-account long-press (report/block) path was not exercised via UI but the report/block/unblock branches are covered by backend tests and the JSX renders those buttons only when sender_id !== me (verified via code review).
critical_code_review_comments: team_chat.py:33 _require_chat_guidelines is only called by POST /messages; accept-guidelines endpoint doesn't require chat access (uses get_current_user) which is fine but note that non-chat-eligible users could pre-accept — harmless.
team_chat.py:181 flag_message requires chat access + message must belong to caller's hub (household match) — good; duplicates prevented via upsert on (message_id,user_id).

moderation.py:16 substring profanity filter may flag legitimate words containing 'ass' etc. — current banned list is conservative (whole words like 'asshole') so acceptable; consider word-boundary regex if false positives arise.
chat.tsx:104 send() shows guidelines modal both when guidelinesOk=false locally and when server returns 403 — good defensive UX; text is restored on failure.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 owner + 3 personnel signup accounts per test run (throwaway *_@t.com). Reset applereview@cheerplanner.app chat_guidelines_accepted_at=unset to exercise the frontend modal (re-accepted during test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for team chat moderation live under /api/team/chat/* — guidelines gate, /flag, /block, /unblock, /blocks, DELETE messages/{id}, GET /flags (admin). Admin account: reviewsadmin@cheerplanner.app / AdminRev2026! (is_admin=true). To reset applereview's guidelines: db.users.update_one({'email':'applereview@cheerplanner.app'},{'$unset':{'chat_guidelines_accepted_at':''}}). Frontend testIDs on /team/chat: team-chat-screen, chat-input, chat-send, chat-guidelines-modal, chat-accept-guidelines, chat-msg-<id>, chat-actions-modal, chat-action-delete, chat-action-report, chat-action-block. Signup endpoint is 10/min per IP — pace signups.
